    Profile

    Ambrosia is a woman from the Luxuria Belt Region whom Mira and Nyx knew as master. She may appear rather young, but in fact, her age is a whole digit greater than the twins'. She conducts research into various fields in order to promote life in the belt regions. The magil amplifier-measurer that covers her right eye is just one of the fruits of her labor.

    Origin: The Luxuria Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 160cm
    Weight: 44kg
    Birthday: Jun 28
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Dark Magic Dragon
    Likes: Foolish pupils
    Hobbies: Entertaining customers
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 嶋村侑
